name: foodsaver-direct-connect-root
description: Root workspace runner for Food Saver Direct Connect

scripts.build: cd foodsaver/frontend && npm install && npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('../../dist', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('dist', '../../dist', {recursive:true});"
scripts.build:frontend: cd foodsaver/frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
